g.text: A card game for two to four players where the table changes every round. Play solo through
the House Circuit or pass the device around.
Local play, optional accounts and invite links.
Deterministic protocols and heuristic bots keep hands different.
Twelve stages, companions and a cast of rivals.
The table and its card language · current artwork
Seat two to four players or bots.
Lay cards, chain effects and score.
A new Protocol changes the table.
